const update =
  $('Prepare Opportunity Update')
    .first()
    .json ?? {};

const action =
  String(update.action ?? '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase();

const messages = {
  mark_applied:
    'Opportunity marked as applied.',

  skip:
    'Opportunity marked as skipped.',

  explore_adjacent:
    'Adjacent-role contact research started.',

  explore_speculative:
    'Speculative contact research started.',

  move_to_manual_outreach:
    'Opportunity moved to Manual Outreach.',

  save_manual_contact:
    'Manual contact saved. Fresh outreach draft generation started.',
};

return [
  {
    json: {
      success: true,

      message:
        messages[action] ||
        'Opportunity updated successfully.',

      opportunity_key:
        update.opportunity_key,

      action:
        update.action,

      previous_status:
        update.previous_status,

      application_status:
        update.application_status,

      outreach_mode:
        update.outreach_mode,

      contact_research_status:
        update.contact_research_status,

      manual_contact_status:
        update.manual_contact_status,

      contact_source:
        update.contact_source,

      applied_at:
        update.applied_at,

      last_updated:
        update.last_updated,
    },
  },
];
